company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech in the financial-services industry, providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing context and supporting colleagues, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and reducing unnecessary complexity to serve clients quickly.

The company describes a collaborative, commercially driven working environment, with hybrid work—typically three days a week in the office—and teams organised around product areas such as payments, risk, data platform and client experience. It also offers career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring. Employee reviews are mixed: colleagues are often described as friendly, while onboarding and training can vary between teams; culture ratings are slightly below those of similarly sized financial-services companies.

work_context.location_limits: Lisbon, Portugal; 3 days per week in the office. No other location or work-eligibility limits stated.
culture_signals: Values: Together (share context openly and help across teams), Ownership (own, fix and learn from problems), and Pace (reduce unnecessary complexity to move quickly).
The company describes a collaborative environment focused on teamwork and personal development.
Company materials describe a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues; reviewers say onboarding and training vary between teams.
Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how the company builds connections.
work_context.notes: The ad specifies hybrid work from a central Lisbon office, 3 days per week. The company pages also say Lisbon is hybrid with 3 days in the office, so there is no stated difference.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
